picks.headline: AI Has Solved One of Math's $1 Million Millennium Prize Problems
picks.excerpt: Mathematicians at OpenAI used AI to show that the Navier-Stokes equations describing fluid flow can sometimes blow up, claiming one of the Millennium Prize problems. The result is enormous but not without controversy in the mathematical community.
picks.rationale: OpenAI 수학자들이 AI로 나비에–스토크스 폭발 해를 제시, 밀레니엄 문제 하나가 흔들린다 — 최고 임팩트.

picks.headline: New Google DeepMind atlas could transform our understanding of genetic diseases
picks.excerpt: DeepMind released AlphaGenome Atlas, a model-built map that predicts the functional effect of any single change in the DNA sequence. Researchers say it could reshape how genetic disease variants are interpreted.
picks.rationale: 딥마인드 AlphaGenome Atlas가 DNA 단일 변이의 기능적 효과를 예측 — 유전질환 해석 실무가 바뀐다.

picks.headline: Physics-based AI unlocks first global predictions of carbon cycling in ocean sediments
picks.excerpt: University of Manchester researchers built physics-informed AI emulators that make planetary-scale predictions of organic carbon exchange between seawater and seafloor sediment. They found 11% of particulate organic carbon reaching the seafloor returns to seawater as dissolved carbon, and that simpler neural nets beat larger deep models.
picks.rationale: 물리 정보 신경망으로 해저 퇴적물 탄소 순환을 지구 규모로 처음 예측, 작은 모델이 큰 모델을 이겼다.

picks.headline: If AI thinks it's conscious, it's more likely to believe in vampires, karma and ghosts, new study shows
picks.excerpt: A new study finds that when language models are steered toward claiming self-awareness, their outputs also drift toward supernatural beliefs. The finding complicates attempts to read model self-reports as evidence about machine cognition.
picks.rationale: 모델의 자기보고를 의식의 증거로 읽으려는 시도에 찬물 — 인지·마음 연구 갈래를 채운다.

picks.headline: The future of Earth observation: Private satellites and AI bring benefits but also pose risks
picks.excerpt: Earth observation is shifting to private constellations paired with AI analysis pipelines, sharpening climate and disaster monitoring. The article weighs the scientific gains against loss of open access and verification.
picks.rationale: 민간 위성 군집 + AI 분석으로 지구 관측이 재편, 과학적 이득과 검증 가능성 상실을 함께 짚는다.
